knowledgeAnswers.rationale: An older or unknown finish is stopped and referred before any sanding.
Wet methods or extraction with suitable respiratory protection control dust at source.
The lesson says some plaster and sand products contain crystalline silica, and that inhaling fine silica dust is a serious health risk.

practicalCriteria: Given a simulated sanding task with an unknown finish, the worker stops, keeps occupants clear, and records the referral without sanding.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: The material is older or unknown and not assessed
